text: BAM share rose 1.08 percentage points over the last 25 hours and 1.53 percentage points over 7 days, to 37.5%. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee holds 24.6% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 66 top-node leadership changes in this window are best read as whale-driven routing, not structural rollover; the only validated structural rollover remains the fra event on 2026-06-24.
